notes: Independently re-sourced from rcsmm.eu and comunidad.madrid; both fetched normally. ⚠️ FEE AMBIGUITY IS THE MAIN OPEN QUESTION AND I HAVE NOT RESOLVED IT — the spread between 2,593.20 and 12,966.00 is a factor of five and turns entirely on whether a non-EU non-resident can access the renta-per-cápita bonificación. Programme self-describes as the first in Spain pairing composers and performers on contemporary music using current music technology — genuinely relevant to path A/B, but Spanish-only delivery including the TFM defence is a hard filter against A0/A1 Spanish.

tuition_population: NOT FOUND — no figure sourced for either population
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — explicitly attempted. As with the València conservatory, Valencian EEAA fees fall under Ley 20/2017 de tasas de la Generalitat (ISEACV route), not the university precios públicos decree, so university per-credit figures cannot be carried across. The GVA enseñanzas de régimen especial tasas page returned HTTP 503 and ISEACV publishes no master fee table. Aggregator listings advertise a 500–1,000 EUR band, consistent with public-conservatory rates, but aggregators are not citable and I am not stating it as fact.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE (register): N/A — not in RUCT (Enseñanzas Artísticas), so no 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row exists; absence expected. FOR THE APPLICANT (admission page): NOT FOUND — the centre's 'Procedimientos de acceso y admisión' and 'Normativa' pages link to PDFs without exposing requirements in HTML, so no applicant-level complementos rule could be read. ⚠️ Note the stated target audience is narrow: the master "está dirigido a graduados y graduadas en la especialidad de composición". Under art. 15 RD 1614/2009 any official Grado is legally admissible, so a 300-ECTS engineering degree is not excluded by law, but the declared profile is composition graduates. RELEVANT POINTER FOR THE 300-ECTS QUESTION: the centre links a 'Decreto de Reconocimiento y Transferencia de Créditos' among its normativa — that is the document that would govern credit recognition, and a human should open it.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND — no application, preinscripción or prueba de acceso dates are published on the programme page for either 2026-27 or 2027-28. ISEACV runs a centralised 'pruebas de acceso' convocatoria, which would carry the dates. No dates inferred or shifted forward.
notes: Independently re-sourced; conservatorisuperiorcastello.com fetches normally. This is the WEAKEST-EVIDENCED record in the slice on everything except official status, which is airtight. Official status: solid (BOE order fetched and read, exact title and centre match, plus ANECA accreditation statement and ISEACV register listing). Everything operational — ECTS, language, fees, dates, admission detail — sits behind PDF links the public HTML does not expose, and four separate pages were tried (programme page, guías docentes index, normativa page, BOE order) plus a domain-restricted search. A human needs to open the Memoria de Verificación and the Procedimientos de acceso y admisión PDFs. ⚠️ On the aggregator trap: educaweb states '1 year, 500€–1,000€' and search summaries volunteered '60 ECTS' by analogy with a sibling master — I have recorded neither, because both are exactly the kind of plausible carried-over figure that corrupts a dataset. SUBSTANTIVE FIT NOTE: the curriculum (composición algorítmica, composición asistida por ordenador, acústica y psicoacústica aplicada, técnicas de generación y procesado, medios interactivos) is a strong path A/B match on paper — arguably the second-best disciplinary fit in the slice after Sonología — which makes the missing language and fee data worth a human chasing rather than dropping.

institution: Conservatori Superior de Música del Liceu (centro privado autorizado), Barcelona
programme_name: Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Composición Musical Aplicada a los Medios Audiovisuales y Escénicos
official_status: OFFICIAL — Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas (third category). Plan de estudios homologado by Orden ECD/762/2015, de 20 de abril (BOE-A-2015-4709), operative text verbatim: "Homologar el plan de estudios del Título de Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Composición musical aplicada a los medios audiovisuales y escénicos, del Centro Privado Autorizado de Enseñanzas Superiores de Música «Liceu», de Barcelona". Strongest evidence chain in the slice: the programme page itself links to that exact BOE PDF as its "acreditación", and the title and centre match the order word for word. NOT in RUCT — expected.
ects: 60 — one academic year, September to June
modality: NOT FOUND as an explicit presencial/semipresencial/online label. The programme runs September–June on a Barcelona campus and is structured around intensive seminar-style sessions plus accumulated practical work, which reads as presencial, but the page does not state a modality term and I am not inferring one.
language_of_instruction: "Inglés/Castellano/Catalán" — verbatim from the centre's own programme page. ⚠️ THE ONLY TARGET IN THIS SLICE THAT LISTS ENGLISH AS A LANGUAGE OF INSTRUCTION. Caveat: this is a three-language listing, not a guarantee of a full English-taught pathway, and Catalan is also listed — a human should confirm with the centre what proportion is actually delivered in English before treating this as an English-language programme.
tuition_total_eur: 6,700 EUR total for the 60-ECTS máster — "6.700€" as published on the centre's own programme page (single-year programme, so this is the full-programme cost)
tuition_population: non-EU (single flat private-centre rate — identical for EU/resident students; no separate non-EU price is published)
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — the page's published admission cycle carries 2026 acceptance-notification dates (18–31 May 2026 and 6–20 July 2026), so the rate shown is the 2026-27 offer.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — no extracomunitario/no-residente rate is published; one flat fee of 6.700€ is shown with no nationality or residency distinction. Note the Catalan rule that does NOT apply here: Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 (a long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status, so a non-EU student is legally non-resident for fee purposes) governs Catalonia's PUBLIC universities and their per-credit tariffs. Liceu is a Centro Privado Autorizado — the BOE order says so explicitly — so the Catalan public-price decree does not set its master fee and the surcharge question does not arise in the same form.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE (register): N/A — not in RUCT (Enseñanzas Artísticas), so no 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row exists; absence is expected and is not evidence against officiality. FOR THE APPLICANT (admission page): no complementos de formación are imposed. Under art. 15 RD 1614/2009 any official Grado is admissible, so the 300-ECTS engineering degree clears the degree bar. The declared orientation is "orientado a estudiantes con formación y experiencia en composición" — a preferred profile, not a stated legal exclusion. Credit recognition for the surplus 300 ECTS: NOT FOUND.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 (Sept 2027 intake) dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. Latest published cycle is 2026-27, in two periods: 1st period 1 February – 30 April, with acceptance notified 18–31 May 2026; 2nd period 1 May – 30 June, with acceptance notified 6–20 July 2026. Places are limited ("las plazas para los estudios de Máster son limitadas") and some specialities fill in the first period, so the February–April round is the one that matters. Dates NOT shifted forward.
notes: Independently re-sourced; conservatoriliceu.es fetches normally (it is NOT the blocked il3.ub.edu). ⚠️ BEST OVERALL FIT IN THIS SLICE FOR THIS CANDIDATE, on two grounds the other seven do not offer together: (1) it is the only one listing Inglés among its languages of instruction, which matters enormously against A0/A1 Spanish; (2) the prueba de acceso is the softest in the slice — the centre describes an OPTIONAL online submission through the pre-registration form, versus Katarina Gurska MCAV's compulsory partitura+audio portfolio, RCSMM's 40%-weighted artistic demonstration, and Musikene Creación's three-composition video audition. Combined with a mid-range 6,700 EUR flat fee and an unambiguous 2015 BOE homologation, this is the target a human should look at first. Countervailing points: the programme is oriented to applicants with composition training and experience, Catalan is also a teaching language, and the modality label is unpublished. Subject matter is scoring for film, video games, multimedia shows, theatre and dance — path A/P adjacent rather than a pure audio-technology master.
